testCases.title: Create a market order
flags: Secret-like value masked in step at line 7 (1x)
Step at line 24 refers to file 'schemas/order-response.json' from the automation repo - the tester needs access to it

rows.source: Given the API base URL is "https://api.stockbroker.test"

When a POST request is sent to "/v1/orders" with body:
{
  "clientId": "TRD1001",
  "symbol": "AAPL",
  "side": "BUY",
  "type": "MARKET",
  "quantity": 10
}
rows.sourceExpected:
Then the response status code is 201
And the response body field "status" is "FILLED"
And the response matches the schema "schemas/order-response.json"

When a GET request is sent to "/v1/orders/ORD-5001" with query parameters:

rows.sourceExpected:

orderId = ORD-5001
